# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c28 P3](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0003), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c36 P23](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0023), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Ruby is a very handsome young lady with long, golden hair, large bright-blue eyes, a brilliant complexion, and a plump, showy figure. Her appearance is characterized by snap and color. She wears her skirts long when permitted and puts her hair up in town.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c28 P3](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0003), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

## Personality

Ruby is cheerful, good-tempered, and enjoys life's pleasant things frankly. She is inclined to be nervous and prone to hysterics during alarming situations. She is particularly obsessed with young men and romantic suitors, thinking of little else as she grows older.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 c28 P13](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0013), [v1 c28 P36](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0036), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

## History

While sitting in front of Gilbert Blythe in Avonlea school, Gilbert pinned Ruby's long braid to her seat, causing her to cry when her hair was pulled as she stood up. She took part in climbing a willow tree on a dare from Carrie Sloane despite her fear of caterpillars. When Anne Shirley fell off the Barry roof, Ruby went into hysterics, a reaction she repeated when Anne floated down the pond on a flat. Under Miss Stacy's instruction, Ruby prepared a dialogue called 'A Morning Visit' with Diana Barry and Jane Andrews, and participated in a school concert tableau dressed in white as 'Faith, Hope, and Charity'. She passed the Entrance examination for Queen's Academy and subsequently attended Queen's, where she studied for her teaching certificate. After graduating, she secured a teaching position at a school up west.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c28 P36](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0036), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c36 P23](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0023), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)_
